verified_facts.text: The hotel was built in 1857 by architect Enrico Marconi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Raffles Europejski Warsaw was built in 1857 by Enrico Marconi

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds a collection of 500 modern and contemporary artworks by more than 120 artists.
verified_facts.excerpt: Home to a collection of 500 modern and contemporary artworks by over 120 artists

verified_facts.text: The Immersive Art Retreat package includes a private tour guided by the hotel's Art Collection Manager.
verified_facts.excerpt: On your two-night stay, enjoy a private tour guided by our Art Collection Manager, and take home the souvenir album.

verified_facts.text: Lourse Warszawa is a reinvention of the patisserie where Warsaw society met over tea and confections in the early 20th century.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the early 20th century, the cream of Warsaw society met over tea and exquisite confections at Lourse Warszawa.

verified_facts.text: Europejski Grill reinterprets Polish culinary heritage through a modern European lens.
verified_facts.excerpt: A signature restaurant where Polish culinary heritage is reinterpreted through a modern European lens.

verified_facts.text: Long Bar Warsaw's cocktails are inspired by the Raffles Long Bar in Singapore.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Long Bar features a dazzling selection of cocktails, inspired by the famous Raffles Long Bar in Singapore

verified_facts.text: The Humidor is a salon for cigars and rare spirits.
verified_facts.excerpt: An intimate salon for cigars and rare spirits, designed for quiet conversation and unhurried evenings.

verified_facts.text: Europejski Grill Terrace offers seasonal al fresco dining with Mediterranean flavours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seasonal al fresco dining shaped by Mediterranean flavours and a refined sense of place.

verified_facts.text: Raffles Spa uses Aromatherapy Associates and Sisley products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Raffles Spa features bespoke rejuvenating treatments using Aromatherapy Associates and Sisley products, inspired by Asian, Middle Eastern and European traditions.

verified_facts.text: The spa has an indoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Facilities include six soothing treatment rooms and a state-of-the-art upstream indoor pool.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a gym with optional personal training.

verified_facts.text: Each room comes with personalized service from Raffles Butlers.

verified_facts.text: Suite stays include welcome champagne on arrival and 24-hour Raffles butler service.

verified_facts.text: Rooms blend design with contemporary Polish art.
